name: Venomancer: the Fungarian wears Ascension's fungarian model
contract: Fungal Assailant (504344) summons the Fungarian (45896). Every live client capture of its creature cache in AscensionDB (2026-06-29 to 2026-09-09) and the Exiles DB give display 49116 and creature type 4 (Elemental). Display 49116 is Creature\fungarian\fungarian.mdx with the fungarian_green texture at DBC scale 1.0 in both the server and client CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc; the previous template used 18227, the purple Outland Fungal Giant, at 0.5 as a Beast.
